entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello... yes, I need to return something. My VeloBand. It's not working right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's definitely a fault. The thing is just... garbage. It won't connect to my phone. I've tried everything I can think of.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the connection. I can definitely help you with that. I have a set of troubleshooting steps here that usually resolves that issue in just a couple of minutes. Do you have the VeloBand with you now?
Uhm, I do, but... that sounds complicated. I really don't have time to go through a bunch of steps. I just thought it would work. Can't you just help me? I just want my money back.

I understand you'd prefer a direct return. Looking at your account, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 15 days ago. For this particular device, our policy for a straightforward return is within a 10-day window.
Ten days? I... I didn't see that on the website. I'm so confused. I thought it was 10 days or something. This is all very overwhelming.

I apologize for any confusion. That 10-day policy is specific to the VeloBand Pulse because once it's activated, it links securely to a user's account. Since you're reporting a defect outside that window, our process requires us to verify the fault through troubleshooting. Without that verification, I can't process a refund.
So you won't give me a refund? I'm telling you it's broken. I feel like I'm stuck with this piece of garbage now. I don't understand why this is so difficult.

I'm unable to authorize a return without first attempting to resolve or verify the issue, as per our policy for claims made after 10 days. The troubleshooting really is quite simple, and I can walk you through every step. It's the only path forward for a defective claim at this stage.
I just... I can't. I don't have the energy for that. I thought this would be easy. I don't know what to do now.

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry this isn't the resolution you were hoping for. The offer to troubleshoot stands if you change your mind. We are here to help if you do. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
